message:
All files for Phase 2 already exist and are correctly implemented. Here's a summary of the verification:

**Build**: `tsc --noEmit` — ✅ passes with zero errors

**Tests**: 6 suites, 70 tests — ✅ all pass

**Files verified**:

| File | Status |
|------|--------|
| `src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts` | ✅ `PgBalanceRepository` with all 6 methods, uses shared `pool`, `deductDays` with SQL `CASE WHEN` for exhausted status |
| `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` | ✅ `BalanceService` implementing `IBalanceService`, throws `BalanceNotFoundError`/`InsufficientBalanceError`, accepts pre-calculated day count |
| `src/modules/balance/balance.controller.ts` | ✅ Fastify handlers for `getBalance` and `getBalances` |
| `src/modules/balance/balance.routes.ts` | ✅ Fastify plugin exporting `balanceRoutes` |
| `src/modules/audit-log/audit-log.repository.ts` | ✅ `PgAuditLogRepository` with `findByEntity`, `create`, `findAll` (dynamic WHERE with indexed placeholders) |
| `tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.repository.spec.ts` | ✅ 12 tests, mock pg Pool |
| `tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.spec.ts` | ✅ 11 tests, mock IBalanceRepository |
| `tests/unit/modules/audit-log/audit-log.repository.spec.ts` | ✅ 9 tests, mock pg Pool |

**Constraints satisfied**: No `any` types, all DB access through repositories, no hardcoded secrets, no `@gestalt/*` deps, `BalanceStatus` imported from `src/shared/types`, all imports follow module boundaries, calendar days inclusive rule applied.
